verdict.rationale: Synonyms are clearly documented as an index-level relevancy feature. Curation, however, appears only as a pricing-page line item, 'Dynamic Search Rules — boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request,' with no docs describing how to set up per-query rules. That line also names 'bury', not hide. Missing for 10: first-party docs or an API reference for pin/boost rules, explicit per-query targeting, an explicit hide/exclude capability, clarity on plan availability, and hands-on corroboration.
